description: Derivative-computation drills: power/root/algebraic functions, trig functions, exponential functions, logarithmic functions, proving a derivative equals a given rational expression, second derivatives, and partial-fraction-then-differentiate multi-part problems (used to prep for rational-function full studies).

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math exercise compendium (Start Up Community), Lesson 4: ដេរីវេនៃអនុគមន៍ (Derivative of Functions) — exercises only, no worked solutions
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-28

exercises.technique: Compute the derivative of polynomial/power/composite-power/root/rational functions using power rule, chain rule (u^n)'=nu'u^{n-1}, and quotient rule
Compute derivatives of trig, exponential, and logarithmic functions using (sin u)'=u'\cos u, (e^u)'=u'e^u, (\ln u)'=u'/u, plus product/quotient rule

exercises.prompt_latex: f(x)=(x^2-4x+8)/(x-2)\Rightarrow f'(x)=x(x-4)/(x-2)^2\ \text{on}\ \mathbb R-\{2\};\ f(x)=(x^2+3x+3)/(x+2)\Rightarrow f'(x)=(x+3)(x+1)/(x+2)^2;\ f(x)=(x^2-9)/(4-x^2)\Rightarrow f'(x)=-10x/(4-x^2)^2\ \text{on}\ \mathbb R-\{-2,2\};\ f(x)=x/e^x\Rightarrow f'(x)=(1-x)/e^x;\ f(x)=e^x/x^2\Rightarrow f'(x)=(x-2)e^x/x^3;\ f(x)=x/2+\ln x/x\Rightarrow f'(x)=(x^2+2-2\ln x)/(2x^2)\ \text{on}\ x>0;\ f(x)=x(1+e^{-x})\Rightarrow f'(x)=1+e^{-x}(1-x);\ f(x)=\ln(e^x/(e^x+1))\Rightarrow f'(x)=1/(1+e^x);\ f(x)=\ln((x-3)/(x+2))\Rightarrow f'(x)=5/[(x-3)(x+2)];\ f(x)=x+e^x/(2(e^x-2))\Rightarrow f'(x)=(e^x-1)(e^x-4)/(e^x-2)^2
exercises.technique: Verify a claimed closed-form derivative by differentiating and algebraically simplifying to match the target expression

exercises.prompt_latex: y=\cos x/(1+\sin x),\ \text{find}\ f'(2024\pi)\ \text{and}\ f'(2025\pi/2);\ g(x)=\sin3x+\cos3x,\ \text{find}\ g+g'+g''+g''';\ f(x)=(x^2+2x-4)/(x-1)=ax+b+c/(x-1),\ \text{find}\ a,b,c\ \text{then}\ f',f'',f''';\ f(x)=(2x-3x^2+4)/(x+2)=Ax+B+C/(x+2),\ \text{find}\ A,B,C\ \text{then}\ f',f'',f'''
exercises.technique: Combine differentiation with algebraic decomposition or evaluation at specific points
Functions built for later curve-study use (x e^{-x} type, log/exp with partial fractions): decompose into partial fractions first, then differentiate repeatedly
Semester-1 review bank (section IV): comprehensive derivative-computation review spanning power/composite, trig, exponential, and log functions

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{find}\ a,b,c\ \text{s.t.}\ f(x)=(x^2+2x-4)/(x-1)=ax+b+c/(x-1),\ x\ne1,\ \text{compute}\ f',f'',f''';\ f(x)=(2x-3x^2+4)/(x+2)=Ax+B+C/(x+2),\ \text{compute}\ f',f'',f''';\ g(x)=(2x-4)/(x^2-1)=a/(x-1)+b/(x+1),\ \text{compute}\ g',g'',g''';\ h(x)=(5x+4)/[(x+2)(x-1)]=A/(x+2)+B/(x-1),\ \text{compute}\ h',h'',h''',h^{(4)};\ f(x)=(5x-1)/(1-x-2x^2)=m/(x+1)+n/(2x-1),\ \text{compute}\ f',f'',f''',f^{(4)};\ \text{find}\ a,b,c\ \text{s.t.}\ f(x)=x^3+ax^2+bx+c\ \text{has khsae kong C, tangent slope 0 at}\ x=-1,\ f(-2)=1;\ \text{find}\ m\ \text{s.t.}\ f(x)=(m+1)/[(x+m)\ln x]\ \text{has extremum at}\ x=1/e;\ f(x)=e^x/(ax+b),\ \text{compute}\ f',f''\ \text{as functions of}\ a,b,\ \text{find}\ a,b\ \text{s.t. minimum}=e\ \text{at}\ x=1;\ f(x)=(x^2+bx+c)/(x^2+dx-2),\ \text{find}\ b,c,d\ \text{knowing curve C touches x-axis at O and has vertical asymptote}\ x=1
exercises.technique: Semester-1 review bank (section V): partial-fraction decomposition combined with repeated differentiation, and word problems requiring an unknown coefficient from tangent-slope/extremum/asymptote conditions
